title: Understanding Confidence Intervals
text: A 95% confidence interval means that if we were to take many samples and construct a confidence interval for each one, about 95% of those intervals would contain the true population mean, not the sample mean.

title: Sample Mean vs. Population Mean
text: Remember, the sample mean is an estimate of the population mean. Confidence intervals are used to estimate where the true population mean lies, not the sample mean.

title: Clarifying the Statement
